name: stock
description: the true floor: the game and UE4SS alone — no ReShade, no RenoDX, no DLSSNR, neither C++ mod loaded

report.verdict: the zero-point a performance number is honest against

payloads.note: removing the ReShade proxy removes ReShade and every addon with it
OptiScaler's nine libraries live in this folder. Stated as a tree so the floor's guarantee is 'no OptiScaler here' rather than 'none of the nine files someone remembered to list'

expect.note: UE4SS LoadLibrary's dlls/main.dll for every mod folder that has a dlls directory and gates only start_mod on enabled.txt, so the DLL IS mapped into the process here - measured, and confirmed in UE4SSProgram.cpp. What this profile asserts is that the mod never STARTS: it rotates its log on start, so a cell of its own with no log lines at all is the evidence

manual.driver_vsync: the owner's word — not readable from a script
manual.monitors: three: 1920x1080 @ 75 Hz primary, 1920x1080 @ 100 Hz, 1080x1920 @ 75 Hz rotated; the game runs on the primary
